en: Colorized street scene showing a central European square with a tram, pedestrians, and ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. In the middle stands a monument in Prešeren Square, with the Franciscan Church area and bridge in the background. The caption on the front is in German and labels the view as Laibach (Ljubljana), Prešeren-Platz with the Franciscan Bridge. The reverse has handwritten German text, an Austrian stamp, and a Laibach postmark.
